reviews.comment: Took in Fall 2025. The class was very manageable overall. Attendance is required, and lectures are delivered clearly with step by step explanations. The first few weeks focus on lecture, and the remainder of the course transitions into hands on learning with Revit. Overall, it was a straightforward class and a good introduction to the software.

She was a great professor—lectures were clear, and she explained things multiple times to make sure everyone understood. She's super helpful with assignments and really wants you to succeed. The class was easy, paced slowly, and manageable if you put in the effort and do the work in class.
